known.title: The scheduled guard's Blacksmith CLI install has no time bound, so a stalled download blocks the fallback
known.summary: The Pattern 3 guard installs the Blacksmith CLI with `curl -fsSL https://get.blacksmith.sh | sh` in a `continue-on-error` step (runner-fallback.md:95-96) that has no step `timeout-minutes` and no curl `--max-time`. `continue-on-error` only covers an installer that exits. A stalled installer response or download can use the whole 15-minute job limit (line 91), so the decide step never runs, the cost is never counted as unknown, and the variables never switch to the GitHub-hosted fallback. The install must be bounded well below the job limit so that expiry reaches the unknown-cost fallback.

known.title: The checkout notes say that `git log -- <path>` in a blobless clone fetches file contents
known.summary: github-actions.md:92 says that in a blobless clone `git log -- <path>` and `git blame` fetch file contents over the network. The partial-clone article that the line links says that path history runs from the local commits and trees; only `git blame` and patch output (`git log -p`) need blobs. The skill so teaches a wrong cost of path-history commands in `filter: blob:none` checkouts.

known.title: The Effect diagnostics annotation step is skipped when the type check fails
known.summary: The GitHub Actions recipe runs `bun run typecheck` (lint-setup.md:105) and then the `effect-tsgo diagnostics --format github-actions --strict` step (line 106) with no `if:`. A floating Effect fails the type check, and the default `success()` condition then skips the annotation step, so the recipe gives no pull-request annotations exactly for the blocking findings that line 101 says it annotates. The annotation step needs `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}` while the type check stays the gate.
